data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads size_action from the classifier JSON output; when size_action=upgrade, routes to the deep tier model; verified by a test that injects a classifier response with size_action=upgrade and asserts the runner dispatches a deep-model call.
- DD4: A diff of any size is reviewed without error — there is no hard line-count cap that causes the runner to exit early or skip review.

## What to implement
Add one new test function to tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh that fails (RED) until the runner is updated to consume size_action:

test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier():
  Given: a mock classifier that returns selected_tier="light" and size_action="upgrade"
  When: ci-llm-review-runner.sh runs against a small diff
  Then: the runner dispatches a "deep"-tier call (uses deep model agent files, not light)
  Assertion: verify the runner invokes a deep-tier agent (check REVIEW_TIER or that a deep-tier agent file path is used)

Also add test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block():
  Given: a mock classifier that returns selected_tier="light" and size_action="warn"
  When: ci-llm-review-runner.sh runs against a diff
  Then: the runner completes without error (exit 0) and does not skip review — proceeds with light tier
  Assertion: exit code 0 and review tier is "light" (warn does not cause upgrade)

Look at existing tests for patterns on how to mock the classifier (the tests use a fake review-complexity-classifier.sh that echoes a fixed JSON response). Follow the same mock injection pattern.

Both tests MUST add RED markers to .test-index before committing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|FAIL" | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier exists in tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier' tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block exists in tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block' tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier
  Verify: grep '\[test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block
  Verify: grep '\[test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] New tests fail before Task 4 implementation (confirms RED phase)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL\|Error'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add failing test for runner size_action=upgrade routing to deep tier
